_help: Site-wide settings. Edit values, commit, and Vercel rebuilds the site automatically.
name: GamerVault
_formEndpoint_help: Paste a Formspree form URL here (looks like https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz). Leave empty and every form shows a clear 'prototype' notice instead of sending.
_showDrafts_help: true = draft articles are visible with a 'Draft' label. Set to false to hide all drafts from the public site.

inkling._help: Inkling preview. When the game is ready: set status to 'Live', availability to 'Play now', and add playUrl (an H5 game URL) to embed it.
inkling.name: Inkling
inkling.description: We're working on Inkling, an H5 game currently under development at GamerVault. It's not live yet, but watch this space!
inkling.longDescription: Inkling is a small, playful H5 game built around handwriting and self-discovery. It is being designed and tested at GamerVault and has not been released yet.
